text:
sam: heads up — got a Grafana alert: remote_write failures + sudden surge of new series from gpu-exporter in us-west2 right after the autoscale event. p95 write latency spiked, remote_write queue length growing.

ina: can you paste the grafana panel / alert, and any prometheus logs you have?

sam: panel -> https://grafana.internal/r/alerts/9234, snapshot attached. logs below (redacted):
```
level=error ts=2026-03-15T09:02:11.123Z caller=queue_manager.go:312 msg="remote_write: send samples failed" err="write tcp 10.12.4.5:43782->10.13.1.12:9090: i/o timeout"
level=info ts=2026-03-15T09:02:12.001 caller=scrape.go:623 msg="Added 1 series" series=gpu_exporter{pod="gpu-pool-23-abc", serial="GPU-12", job="gpu-exporter", region="us-west2"}
level=info ts=2026-03-15T09:02:12.002 caller=scrape.go:623 msg="Added 1 series" series=gpu_exporter{pod="gpu-pool-24-def", serial="GPU-13", job="gpu-exporter", region="us-west2"}
... repeated many slightly different pod/serial labels ...
```

ben: looks like a cardinality spike from exporter labels (serial/pod). after the autoscale new pods have unique suffixes. remote_write timeouts then queue backlog. we should drop the serial label at scrape time.

kevin: +1. immediate mitigation: 1) increase `remote_write` `timeout` from `30s` -> `60s` 2) add a metric_relabel_configs drop for `serial` and `instance` 3) throttle autoscaler to avoid N pod spinups at once.

ben: suggested metric_relabel_configs snippet i can push to staging quickly:
```
metric_relabel_configs:
- source_labels: [serial]
  regex: ".+"
  action: drop
- source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_name]
  regex: "(gpu-pool-).*"
  target_label: pod
  replacement: "${1}"
```

ina: is the exporter emitting any per-job unique ids besides serial? if so drop those too. also check prometheus `queue_config` current size — we hit the shard limit.

sam: current remote_write config (redacted):
```
remote_write:
- url: https://cortex.rw.internal/api/v1/push
  timeout: 30s
  queue_config:
    max_shards: 100
    min_shards: 1
    max_samples_per_send: 1000
```

maria: quick cost note — that 30m spike in series increased outgoing write volume ~3x for the window. if this repeats across regions could be a significant bill. we should prioritize label-drop in prod.

kevin: agree. plan: (a) ben opens PR to add metric_relabel_configs in staging (b) i'll ramp remote_write timeout to 60s and increase max_shards to 300 as temporary backpressure relief (c) sam will add an SLO annotation on the alert to reduce noisy paging.

ben: opening PR now, target staging rollout in 10m and then canary to prod after validation. PR: https://git.internal/r/prometheus-config/changes/482

sam: i'll keep the alert muted for the next 20m while we test, will update status.

deploy-bot: Started rollout prometheus-config/metric-relabel-482 -> staging at 2026-03-15T09:04:10Z :rocket:

kevin: follow-up: we should also add a test in our scrape e2e that ensures exporters don't introduce high-cardinality labels on autoscale. open a tracking ticket.

sam: noted. creating ticket now and tagging infra-team.

maria: thanks — after this we should run a 24h cost delta check for the region and confirm we didn't miss other exporters. :thumbsup:
